packageRules.description: Cooldown before automerge picks up a release: a hijacked package is usually spotted and yanked within days. digest is in here because a digest-only update means an upstream tag moved onto another commit. vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this, so CVE fixes still land at once
Docker digests carry no release timestamp: under the default timestamp-required, minimumReleaseAge held them forever
Automerge all safe updates (minor/patch/digest) via PR once CI passes
Actions do not ship in any artifact -> group them into one chore PR. github-runners is a datasource rather than a manager, so the github-actions manager carries the runner labels too
prek is bumped by the prek-action custom manager below, which also updates the pinned sha256; the built-in one only bumps prek-version and broke the checksum

customManagers.description: prek-action: bump prek-version and its sha256 together. currentValue is the release tag, so keep the v prefix
